nodes.label: Deploy production workflow (manual, reviewer-gated)
nodes.rationale: Merging to main ships code; migrating a database of citizen records is a separate decision. Four gates: manual dispatch, db-production reviewer, typed ref confirmation, deploy.mjs promotion and destructive-DDL checks. confirm_ref passed via env to avoid shell injection.

nodes.rationale: A migration reaches production only after running unattended on staging; concurrency group forbids two migrations against one database.

nodes.label: InternalCronController HTTP cron (CRON_SECRET)
nodes.rationale: ScheduleModule cannot fire on serverless; routes refuse to run when CRON_SECRET is unset because they walk every municipality and issue invoices.

nodes.label: Fee basis FLAT / PER_UNIT / PER_AREA
nodes.rationale: Unsurveyed buildings refuse to be assessed rather than counting as zero, which would make the largest buildings pay nothing.

nodes.label: Fee bearer OCCUPANT vs OWNER
nodes.rationale: A null unit status means 'not asked' and is billed; no 'charge everyone' value because it double-taxes one unit.

nodes.label: Confirmed landlord link (LandlordLinkService.confirm)
nodes.rationale: A phone is not an identity, so nothing links itself; a confirmed link mints a unit-less owner card so heldThroughOccupancy bills owner-borne fees.
